name: @pipeworx/mcp-ripe-stat

tools.name: whois
tools.description: "Whois lookup for IP / ASN / prefix" / "who owns IP [X]" / "WHOIS for [resource]" — aggregated whois data for an IP address, IP prefix, or AS number across all five RIRs (ARIN, RIPE, APNIC, LACNIC, AFRINIC). Returns registrant org, registration country, abuse contacts, allocation date. Use for IP ownership, abuse-response, network forensics.

resource.description: IP address, prefix, or AS number (e.g. "8.8.8.8", "8.8.8.0/24", "AS15169")

tools.name: network_info
tools.description: "What ASN does IP [X] belong to" / "network info for [IP]" / "what prefix is [IP] in" — get the allocated prefix and originating ASN for an IPv4/IPv6 address. Use for "which network owns this IP", DDoS source attribution, hosting-provider lookup.

tools.name: as_overview
tools.description: "Who owns AS[N]" / "AS[number] info" / "what company is ASN [X]" / "Cloudflare / Google / Amazon ASN" — summary for an Autonomous System Number (ASN): holder organization, country, AS type (transit / content / IXP), allocation date. Pass "AS15169" or "15169". Use for network attribution, BGP analysis.

tools.name: asn_neighbours
tools.description: "BGP peers / neighbours of AS[N]" / "who does [ASN] peer with" / "upstream providers for [AS]" — BGP neighbours of an AS observed by RIPE's RIS (Routing Information Service) route collectors. Use for transit / peering analysis, network topology mapping.

tools.name: bgp_state
tools.description: "BGP routes for [prefix]" / "what AS announces [IP]" / "BGP hijack check" / "current routing state for [resource]" — origin ASNs and AS-path lengths currently announcing a resource on the global BGP table. Use to detect BGP hijacks, audit route propagation, find anycast announcers.

tools.name: abuse_contact
tools.description: "Abuse contact for IP [X]" / "where to report abuse on [IP / ASN]" / "report spam from [resource]" — official abuse-contact email(s) for an IP, prefix, or ASN drawn from RIR records (inetnum / aut-num objects). Use for spam/abuse/DDoS report routing.

tools.name: geoloc
tools.description: "What country is IP [X] in" / "geolocate [IP]" / "RIR country for [resource]" — country geolocation of an IP or prefix derived from RIR registration data. NOTE: registration-based geo, not GeoIP — accurate for ownership country but not necessarily the host's physical location. Use for compliance / jurisdiction questions where registry truth matters.

tools.name: prefix_overview
tools.description: "Prefix overview for [CIDR]" / "info on IP block [X/Y]" — comprehensive summary for an IP prefix: BGP announcements, origin ASes, allocation history. Use to understand a whole IP block at once instead of chaining bgp_state + whois.

tools.name: ripestat_announced_prefixes
tools.description: "What IP ranges does AS[N] announce" / "all prefixes for [ASN]" / "what IP blocks does Cloudflare / Google / AWS own" / "netblocks announced by [AS]" — every IPv4 and IPv6 prefix currently announced in global BGP by an Autonomous System, as seen by RIPE's RIS route collectors. AUTHORITATIVE for "which IP ranges belong to this network": use it to build allowlists, attribute traffic to a provider, or size a network's address footprint. Note RIPEstat excludes prefixes seen by fewer than 10 full-feed peers, so very low-visibility announcements are omitted.

tools.name: ripestat_asn_search
tools.description: "What is [company]'s ASN" / "find the AS number for [organisation]" / "search ASNs by name" — resolve an organisation or network name to its AS numbers and prefixes using RIPEstat's resource autocomplete. Returns candidate ASNs with their holder descriptions, so it is the lookup step BEFORE as_overview / ripestat_announced_prefixes / asn_neighbours when you only know the company name. Matches on the registered AS name and holder description across all five RIRs.

query.description: Organisation or network name to search for (e.g. "cloudflare", "deutsche telekom")

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ripe-stat forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ripe-stat pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
